claim: No concurrency/race control exists for simultaneous tasks, candidates, approvals, promotions, or rollback.
decision_blocker: No complete effective flow graph or overlapping-execution receipt proves the universal negative across every named operation.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind every current task, candidate, approval, promotion, and rollback entry point to its exact state writer and concurrency guard; repository-wide keyword absence is insufficient.
reopening_condition: Any named flow, state writer, revision scheme, lock, transaction, compare-and-swap rule, or execution result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main served same-origin with deterministic seeded state and two independently controlled browser contexts.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Overlap two writes for one named flow, then record initial revision, ordered calls, final state, rejection/serialization behavior, URLs, commit, and content digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: Complete effective route plus all state-changing task/candidate/approval/promotion/rollback modules reachable automatically or by current manual action.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether concurrent operations serialize, reject stale state, or race and overwrite one another.

claim: No code-quality/static type/lint/security baseline is selected for implementation artifacts.
decision_blocker: The effective runtime path cannot prove the complete repository-wide implementation baseline, and selected config-name absence is not complete proof.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Identify the authoritative baseline policy and every CI/build entry point governing all current implementation artifacts.
reopening_condition: Any policy, workflow, configuration, implementation language, artifact set, or enforcement result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Clean authoritative-main checkout with the exact active CI configuration and no developer-global tools.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Introduce one bounded lint/type/security fixture in an isolated test branch and retain the exact command, configuration digests, rejection result, and cleanup receipt.
unresolved_current_source_path: Repository-root quality configurations, active GitHub workflows, build scripts, and implementation artifacts governing the effective runtime.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether an authoritative automated gate rejects a known quality, type, lint, or security violation.

claim: No maintainability/deprecation policy limits wrapper accumulation and obsolete-file residue.
decision_blocker: Multiple wrappers and fallbacks are observable, but their existence does not by itself prove absence of an authoritative retirement policy covering all residue.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind the active wrapper/fallback inventory to a governing deprecation policy, owner, retirement criteria, and enforcement mechanism.
reopening_condition: Wrapper chain, fallback inventory, deprecation policy, owner, retirement threshold, or enforcement changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main repository with exact current route graph and approved maintenance-policy source.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Generate a digest-bound active/fallback/obsolete inventory and test one policy threshold or retirement rule against it, retaining the governing clause and result.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-app-current.html → pmp-current-map-v9.json → pmp-route-guardian-current-loader-v14.html → wrapper v4 → wrapper v3, plus fallback paths and any authoritative maintenance policy.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether obsolete wrappers are detected, bounded, warned, or blocked by an enforceable current rule.

claim: No trusted timestamp/order source or monotonic event sequencing is proven for receipts and approvals.
decision_blocker: Wall-clock and local monotonic calls do not establish the complete ordering behavior of every receipt and approval producer.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Enumerate every active receipt/approval producer and bind it to an exact trusted time or logical-order source through transitive calls and storage contracts.
reopening_condition: Receipt producers, approval paths, clock source, sequence contract, storage ordering, or test result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Same-origin current app with deterministic seeded receipt state and controllable clock/skew or two concurrent contexts.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Create two near-simultaneous receipts under forced equal/reversed wall-clock conditions and retain sequence fields, persisted order, source URLs, commit, and digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: All current runtime receipt and approval producers, their transitive helpers, and persisted ledger/storage paths.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether receipts and approvals retain a trusted unambiguous order under clock collision, skew, reload, and concurrent creation.

claim: Receipt/evidence ledgers are not tamper-evident or append-only in implementation.
decision_blocker: Mutable storage calls and missing selected terms do not prove the behavior of every effective receipt/evidence ledger.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Enumerate all active ledgers, mutation APIs, integrity fields, verification routines, and replacement/deletion paths through the complete effective route.
reopening_condition: Ledger schema, storage API, integrity mechanism, verification routine, mutation path, or execution result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Current same-origin app with seeded non-secret ledger entries and direct storage inspection in a supported browser.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Create one entry, alter or replace it through the smallest available storage path, reload and verify whether detection/blocking occurs; retain before/after bytes and digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: Every active receipt/evidence ledger schema and writer reachable from the effective runtime, including localStorage/IndexedDB-backed records and current export/report surfaces.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether prior entries can be modified, deleted, reordered, or replaced without a detectable integrity failure.

claim: Data minimization, user consent, retention display, export, and deletion controls are not implemented in the UI.
decision_blocker: Static source contains storage-cleaning and export-related elements while wrappers suppress or replace controls; the complete final UI claim requires observation and use.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Resolve final frame ancestry, injection order, suppression rules, and visible/usable control set after the manual current-app open path settles.
reopening_condition: Base UI, wrappers, injected scripts, route, browser behavior, or any named control changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Local or deployed same-origin HTTPS current app in a standards browser, with the current route and representative non-secret data.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Open the current door, press Open Latest App, capture final DOM and screenshots, then exercise each named control and retain redacted before/after state plus route/content digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-home-single-v6.html plus wrapper v3, wrapper v4, loader injections, and all current UI suppression/replacement scripts.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether minimization, consent, retention display, export, and deletion controls are simultaneously visible, understandable, and functional.

claim: No full output inventory proves which required human and machine records exist for every packet.
decision_blocker: The effective runtime cannot prove completeness of packet records that are not runtime-reachable, and no authoritative expected-output set is bound here.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind every packet identifier to its authoritative required human and machine outputs, then compare that complete expected set with present artifacts.
reopening_condition: Packet identifiers, output requirements, repository contents, external/private records, or verification method changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main plus the approved packet-law/output index and any authorized external/private evidence boundary.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Generate a digest-bound expected-versus-present matrix for every packet, independently recount it, and retain all missing/extra/ambiguous records.
unresolved_current_source_path: Current runtime packet-output surfaces plus authoritative non-runtime packet law, output indexes, and external/private record locations.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether every required human and machine output exists exactly once and is bound to the correct packet and release identity.

claim: The current freeze covers only the proven current app/source/control path, not every historical or external state.
decision_blocker: Runtime source establishes the present code path but cannot by itself establish the scope and status of every historical, external, private, device, and provider state.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind the authoritative freeze decision to a complete state-domain matrix and exact inclusion/exclusion evidence for every named domain.
reopening_condition: Freeze scope, history, external/private evidence, device/provider state, or governing receipt changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main plus approved historical, external, private, device, and provider evidence boundaries.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Produce and independently verify one digest-bound scope matrix covering current, historical, external, private, device, and provider state, with each cell frozen or explicitly excluded.
unresolved_current_source_path: Current runtime route and freeze receipts together with historical archives and external/private/device/provider state sources outside the route.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether the asserted freeze remains valid when all named non-current state domains are inspected.

claim: The system’s first release scope and minimum viable safe capability are not frozen, increasing risk of building all 30 modules at once.
decision_blocker: Reachable modules and historical scope statements do not prove an approved current first-release acceptance boundary.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind an authoritative release-scope manifest to exact enabled/reachable capabilities, disabled modules, acceptance criteria, and approval.
reopening_condition: Release scope, feature flags, reachable modules, acceptance criteria, or approval changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main plus the approved release-scope decision and effective runtime feature configuration.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Compare one signed/digest-bound release manifest with the effective capability graph and verify that every non-MVP module is absent, disabled, or explicitly deferred.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-current-map-v9.json, current wrapper/application surfaces, feature controls, and any authoritative first-release scope record.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether only the frozen minimum safe release capability can be exercised from the current app.

claim: Installed iPhone Home Screen runtime and cache behavior have not been tested.
decision_blocker: Repository source proves intended routing, not installed-device cache, relaunch, offline, or update behavior.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind the served revision, response headers, service/cache state, exact iPhone/iOS/WebKit version, and installed Home Screen artifact.
reopening_condition: Device, iOS/WebKit, route, cache key, serving headers, deployment revision, or test result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Supported physical iPhone, exact iOS/Safari/WebKit version, HTTPS deployment, and Home Screen installed mode.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Install once, record loaded URLs/digests and headers, cold relaunch online/offline, change one cache key or deployed content digest, relaunch, and retain timestamped before/after receipts.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-app-current.html through the complete primary route plus deployed headers/cache behavior and installed Home Screen state.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Cold launch, relaunch, offline behavior, cache reuse/invalidation, and update pickup in installed mode.

claim: Exact live outermost Resident wrapper order has not been observed.
decision_blocker: Static precedence proves intended source order, not final live frame ancestry and post-load injection order.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Observe every live frame URL, parent/child relation, load event, and injected script order after the manual Open Latest App action settles.
reopening_condition: Route, wrapper, injection timing, origin, browser behavior, or serving revision changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Local or deployed same-origin HTTPS runtime in a standards browser with frame inspection access.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Press Open Latest App once, traverse frame ancestry, record ordered frame/script URLs after settling, hash the receipt, and bind it to commit and source digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-app-current.html → map v9 → Route Guardian v14 → wrapper v4 → wrapper v3 → home v6 plus loader/runtime injections.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Actual outermost-to-innermost frame and script order in the live Resident path.

claim: Clearing browser storage loses saved Resident context; persistence is browser-local and not durable project memory.
decision_blocker: Static localStorage/IndexedDB use predicts loss but does not prove complete user-visible loss or recovery behavior.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind every saved Resident-context key/store and any backup, synchronization, import, or recovery path reachable after clearing site data.
reopening_condition: Storage keys, backup/import path, synchronization, browser/device, or execution result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Supported browser/device with non-secret seeded Resident context and permission to clear all site storage.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Seed identifiable context, verify persistence after reload, clear all site data, reload, attempt normal recovery, and retain before/after key/store inventories and UI state.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-home-single-v6.html and all active Resident-context storage, backup, import, and recovery modules.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether saved context disappears after storage clearing and whether any durable project-memory recovery restores it.

claim: Current loader fallbacks can load older components without a complete mixed-version proof receipt.
decision_blocker: Static fallback declarations do not prove which fallback executes under each failure or whether a complete mixed-version receipt is produced.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind every primary-map, fallback-map, loader, and current-app failure edge to observed loaded versions and receipt generation.
reopening_condition: Map order, fallback files, loader logic, cache behavior, receipt logic, or execution result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Same-origin current app with controllable HTTP responses for primary map, fallback map, loader, and current app.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Fail the primary map once while serving the fallback path, capture all loaded component versions/digests and any emitted receipt, then repeat for one loader/current-app failure edge.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-app-current.html map precedence, pmp-current-map-v9.json, pmp-current-map.json, Route Guardian v14, Route Guardian v9, and current/fallback app selection.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Which older components load during controlled failures and whether the exact mixed-version set is disclosed and proven.

claim: The test design architecture exists only as pre-code design; tests have not yet been generated and executed against the current runtime.
decision_blocker: Repository test-related files are not a complete manifest of generated tests executed against the exact effective runtime graph.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind authoritative test designs to generated executable tests, exact current targets, environment, coverage, and independently verified results.
reopening_condition: Runtime graph, test design, generated tests, environment, coverage threshold, or result changes.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main, exact runtime-graph digest, deterministic test environment, and frozen test manifest.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Generate one digest-bound design-to-test-to-target manifest, execute every listed test against the exact current graph, and retain commands, results, coverage, and artifacts.
unresolved_current_source_path: Current effective runtime graph plus all authoritative test-design, generation, runner, and receipt entry points.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether designed tests exist as executable current-runtime tests and actually run with recorded results.

claim: Mutation testing, fuzzing, property testing, and systematic fault injection are not required or executed.
decision_blocker: Static source cannot establish execution or non-execution of every named dynamic test class, and selected term absence is insufficient.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind each named test class to an authoritative requirement, exact current target, tool/seed/property/fault model, threshold, and execution receipt.
reopening_condition: Targets, tools, seeds, properties, fault model, thresholds, requirements, or results change.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative main and isolated deterministic test environment with the exact effective targets.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Run one bounded campaign for each named class against an identified current target and retain seeds/mutants/faults, commands, outcomes, thresholds, and digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: Current runtime targets plus authoritative test requirements, runners, mutation/fuzz/property/fault configurations, and receipts.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether each named test class is required and executed with meaningful detection results.

claim: Normal Resident reasoning is local deterministic pattern matching and template generation, not a connected AI reasoning engine.
decision_blocker: The direct residentRun body alone does not resolve transitive helpers, optional backend state, injected replacements, configuration, or live network behavior.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Trace residentRun and every transitive call, replacement/injection, backend toggle/configuration, worker endpoint, provider adapter, parser, and network path under effective precedence.
reopening_condition: Resident functions, injected scripts, backend settings, worker/provider configuration, network behavior, or receipts change.
required_environment_and_configuration: Current same-origin app in a standards browser with network capture, once with backend disabled and once with the exact configured backend state.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Submit one fixed prompt with backend off and on, capture complete call graph/network requests and response provenance, and bind the result to frame/script/configuration digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: pmp-home-single-v6.html residentRun plus all transitive helpers, wrapper injections, backend configuration, worker route, and any provider adapter/parser.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether normal Resident reasoning remains fully local/deterministic or invokes a connected reasoning provider under any current configuration.

claim: Candidate observer and baseline comparator do not exist; the system cannot determine whether a candidate improves on the last-known-good app.
decision_blocker: Absence of selected observer/comparator terms does not prove every current candidate, evaluation, approval, and promotion path lacks equivalent behavior.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind every candidate-producing path to current baseline identity, measurement, comparison, decision threshold, and persisted receipt.
reopening_condition: Candidate flow, baseline identity, metrics, comparator, thresholds, promotion logic, or execution results change.
required_environment_and_configuration: Authoritative current app plus one controlled candidate and a frozen last-known-good baseline with deterministic measurements.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Run one candidate through the complete current flow, record whether a baseline is loaded and compared, and retain metrics, decision, source paths, and digests.
unresolved_current_source_path: All current candidate creation, observation, evaluation, approval, promotion, last-good, and rollback paths reachable from runtime or current manual actions.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether a candidate is measured against an identified last-known-good baseline before approval or promotion.

claim: Permissions, capability declaration, memory boundaries, and tool-use policy exist only as design; enforcement is not implemented.
decision_blocker: Policy/design text and missing selected enforcement terms cannot establish the behavior of every current tool, memory, and capability path.
missing_precedence_or_reachability_proof: Bind each declared capability and memory/tool boundary to an executable authorization check, denial path, audit record, and exact effective entry point.
reopening_condition: Policy, capability declarations, memory/tool entry points, authorization code, configuration, or test results change.
required_environment_and_configuration: Current same-origin app with one allowed and one intentionally unauthorized non-destructive test action under exact capability configuration.
smallest_test_and_receipt: Attempt one bounded unauthorized tool or cross-boundary memory action, verify denial before side effect, then run one allowed action and retain policy/configuration, calls, state diff, and audit receipt.
unresolved_current_source_path: All current tool-use, memory-access, capability, permission, worker, and manual-action entry points plus governing policy/configuration.
runtime_behavior_to_test: Whether undeclared or unauthorized actions are blocked at runtime and recorded without side effects.
